apis.name: World Bank Indicators API
apis.summary: Query global development indicators and country-level time series across World Bank datasets.
apis.description: The World Bank Indicators API v2 provides programmatic access to thousands of development indicators and multiple datasets. Requests support country, indicator, date-range, pagination, and response-format parameters. The official documentation states that API keys and other authentication are not required.
apis.pricingSummary: The public Indicators API is documented as accessible without authentication; no explicit pricing or commercial-use statement is asserted in this candidate.

authMethods.details: The official Indicators API documentation states that API keys and other authentication are not necessary.

apis.name: openFDA API
apis.summary: Search and retrieve public FDA datasets covering drugs, devices, foods, and other regulated-product information.
apis.description: The openFDA API exposes searchable FDA datasets through HTTPS JSON endpoints. A free API key increases the documented request allowance; the official authentication page also describes lower unauthenticated limits. The provider warns that openFDA data should not be used as a substitute for professional medical decisions.
apis.pricingSummary: The API key is available free of charge; documented access limits apply and users should review current FDA terms and disclaimers.

authMethods.details: A free API key can be passed using the api_key query parameter; the official page also documents lower per-IP limits without a key.

apis.name: Europe PMC REST API

apis.description: Europe PMC provides a RESTful web service for searching publications and preprints from multiple sources. apis.name: Google Books API
apis.summary: Search and retrieve bibliographic metadata and public volume information from the Google Books catalogue.
apis.description: The Google Books API v1 exposes volume search and retrieval endpoints. Public volume data can be queried using an API key or access token, while private bookshelf resources require user authorization. The API also returns access and sale metadata where available; commercial and content rights remain subject to Google's terms and publisher rights.
apis.pricingSummary: No standalone API price is asserted here; review current Google API terms, quotas, and applicable content or purchase rights.

authMethods.details: Public volume requests can use a Google API key or access token; the key identifies the project and provides quota and reporting.
OAuth 2.0 is required for private user bookshelf data and other user-specific resources.

apis.name: YouTube Data API v3
apis.summary: Retrieve and manage YouTube video, channel, playlist, comment, and related resource metadata.
apis.description: YouTube Data API v3 provides REST resources for videos, channels, playlists, and other YouTube data. Public-data requests can use an API key; operations that access private user data or modify resources require OAuth 2.0. Requests consume project quota, with costs varying by method.
apis.pricingSummary: No per-call monetary price is asserted; access is governed by project quota and current YouTube API Services terms.

authMethods.details: API keys identify projects for requests that retrieve public data such as public video metadata and search results.
OAuth 2.0 is required for private user data and resource insert, update, or delete operations.

apis.description: The Census Data API provides standardized programmatic access to a broad range of Census Bureau datasets. The current developer guidance describes API key registration and use in data requests; dataset availability and supported variables differ by program and release.
apis.pricingSummary: The Census Bureau offers API keys free of charge; query and dataset-specific constraints apply.

authMethods.details: The current Census Data API guidance states that an API key must be included with data queries; keys are registered free of charge.
